title: Every government UFO programme, country by country
note: 44 official UFO programmes in 18 countries, from Sweden's 1946 ghost rocket committee and Project Blue Book to France's GEIPAN, Chile's SEFAA and the Pentagon's AARO: who ran each one, what they found and the official records.

title: Press and researchers
note: Facts, figures, how we source things and free charts for anyone writing about UFO files.

title: Backup copies of every official UFO source
note: Government pages move and vanish, so every official link on our releases and hearings pages now has an archived copy next to it, plus a note on how the list is put together and a ready-made citation.

title: UFO hearings: what was said under oath
note: Every public UFO hearing held by lawmakers since 1966, from the Blue Book era to the 2025 House task force, with who testified, key quotes from the official transcripts and what happened next.

title: Who has testified about UFOs
note: 25 pilots, sailors, scientists, officials, whistleblowers and reporters, including J. Allen Hynek, Carl Sagan, David Fravor and David Grusch, with what each one told Congress.

title: The real wendigo (no antlers)
note: What the Cree, Ojibwe and Innu traditions actually describe, the Swift Runner and Jack Fiddler cases, and how the movies gave it antlers. New art too.

title: Chupacabra: the full story
note: From the 1995 Puerto Rico attacks to the hairless Texas carcasses, what the DNA tests found and the sci-fi movie link.

title: Who was Indrid Cold?
note: The smiling man Woodrow Derenberger met on Interstate 77 in 1966, and how he became the Grinning Man of Mothman lore.

title: Road trip planner
note: Put in where you're starting and where you're headed and it finds every monster museum, famous sighting, mystery and old newspaper story along the road, in driving order. Six ready-made trips too, from Route 66 to Loch Ness.

title: Collector cards and the Halloween hunt
note: 190 creature cards you can only collect by actually going to a real sighting spot. Twelve spooky ones are a Halloween set until November 2.
